scientific_conclusion: Neither dynamic nor static modulation has a positive aggregate point gain over this matched GPU wide-QV-only recipe. Thus the old historical-QV difference cannot serve as evidence for response-module net benefit.
This is a fixed explored-DEV/single-seed result, not a proof that all input-dependent response modulation is useless or equivalent to QV. No beta/LR/rank/step rescue is justified.

The predeclared simplicity/aggregate selection rule now selects bare wide-QV for a possible one-shot formal endpoint confirmation. Removing the unsupported module claim is a scientific consequence, not a reason to hide this control.
